method: Reverse-DCF by bisection: solve the 10-yr free-cash-flow growth rate that sets (PV of 10 years + terminal at 2.5% growth, 10% discount + net cash)/shares equal to the Fri 2026-09-25 close. Excludes banks, insurers, refiners, E&Ps, miners and pre-profit story names. Fundamentals (FCF $bn, shares bn, net cash $bn) are carried from the prior run; only the price is refreshed.
